title: Fiche d'activité — import
description: The JSON file the authoring screen imports, written from a fiche d'activité made from the Confluence template. Version 2. Enum values are the database codes. Tags, safety instructions, tips and materials are names: the file is written before anything exists to point at. `readActivitySheet` in front/src/features/admin/activities-authoring/model/activity.import.ts is what the app actually reads; it only requires `name` and ignores unknown keys. This schema is stricter on purpose: every key is written, its empty value when unset, so the file stays readable for the next person who edits it.

name.description: Name of the activity: the fiche's h1, the one after the template title. Plain text.

description.description: `## Description`: what children do, why the activity is interesting, and what should be known before starting. HTML.

visualBrief.description: Informations row « Visuel principal »: brief of the cover image, plain text. The image itself is picked in the import modal.

practices.description: Row « Pratique »: for an atelier, its practical category or categories.

themes.description: Row « Thème »: stable subject(s) of the activity, distinct from the imaginary and from pedagogical goals. THEME tag names.

rule.description: Row « Règle d'imaginaire »: whether a narrative universe is unnecessary, adaptable or required.

universes.description: Row « Imaginaire »: narrative dressing such as pirates, space or dragons. Empty when there is none. IMAGINARY tag names.

ageMin.description: Row « Âge minimum », in years: 3 from « 3 ans ».

participantsMin.description: Row « Effectif recommandé », lower bound: what the mechanics and safety allow, not the legal maximum. 6 from « 6 à 12 enfants ».

ageVariants.description: Row « Durées selon âge / variantes »: the documented adaptations per age range, with their durations. HTML. Never invent a variant.

hostEffort.description: Row « Mobilisation de l'animateur »: explanations, attention, vigilance and interventions expected from the animator.

hostsRequired.description: Row « Nombre d'animateurs requis ». When the fiche gives a rule or a calculation rather than a number, 0 here and the rule goes in `notes`, as written.

crossSupervision.description: true when the workshop configuration asks for a surveillance transversale.

notes.description: Row « Configuration des ateliers et contraintes d'encadrement »: simultaneous stations, adults per station, cross-station supervision. Also holds a staffing rule that is not a number. HTML.

indoor.description: Row « Lieu de pratique » lists Intérieur. Independent of `outdoor`: both can be true.

outdoor.description: Row « Lieu de pratique » lists Extérieur.

locations.description: Row « Localisation détaillée ». Does not replace `indoor` / `outdoor`. A setting that fits no code is dropped and reported.

conditions.description: Row « Conditions de réalisation »: indispensable space, terrain, weather, water, supervision or accessibility constraints. HTML.

instructions.description: Row « Sécurité »: safety instruction names or slugs from the catalogue, e.g. feu, eau, tranchant, alimentaire, meteo-extreme, premiers-secours. Do not copy the safety checklist.

goals.description: Row « Tags pédagogiques »: concrete objectives such as écoute, coopération or motricité fine. GOAL tag names.

idealFor.description: Row « Idéal pour… »: situations where the activity helps an animator, such as faire connaissance or occuper une transition. IDEAL_FOR tag names.

development.description: Rows « Développement … ». Fill an axis only when the activity actually exercises it. Tag names of the axis' own type.

DEVELOP_PHYSICAL.description: « Développement physique »: motricité fine, motricité globale, équilibre, coordination…

DEVELOP_INTELLECTUAL.description: « Développement intellectuel »: logique, mémoire, observation, stratégie…

DEVELOP_AFFECT.description: « Développement affectif »: reconnaître ses émotions, réguler la frustration, confiance en soi…

DEVELOP_SOCIAL.description: « Développement social »: écoute, coopération, communication, inclusion…

DEVELOP_MORAL.description: « Développement moral / caractère »: autonomie, persévérance, respect, créativité…

DEVELOP_SPIRITUAL.description: « Développement spirituel »: only when the activity genuinely includes meaning, contemplation or inner experience.

tips.description: Names from the tips catalogue (conseils d'animation). A fiche's `#### Conseil` is free text, not a name: leave this empty unless the user gives names.

materials.description: `## Matériel`, one entry per bullet. Whether the activity needs material is derived from this list.

workshops.description: `## Ateliers`, one entry per table row. Only when the activity has parallel stations; skip a row that is only the template's « … ».

steps.description: `## Étapes`, one entry per `### N. <title>`, in the fiche's order. The automatic steps « Rassembler le matériel » and « Regrouper les enfants » are generated by the app and never written. The totals « Temps de jeu » and « Temps de préparation » are computed from the step durations and stored nowhere.

html.description:
Rich text as HTML:

, , ,

  • , . "" when unset.

names.description: Names as the fiche writes them, one per entry, trimmed, without a leading #. A comma or « et » list is split. A name only links if one of that kind exists in the app; the import modal lists the others.

count.description: A plain non-negative number. 0 means not set.

unset.description: No value for a single choice.

name.description: Material name, preferably the catalogue's wording. A name the catalogue lacks is added to it on import.

quantity.description: Quantity, when the bullet clearly states one: "2" from « 2 ballons en mousse », "1 boîte" from « Craie (1 boîte) ». "" otherwise.

materials.description: Column « Matériel »: names from `materials`. A name missing there is added to the activity.

kind.description: From the h3 title: « Préparer le jeu » is PREPARE, « Conclusion » is CONCLUSION, any other title is CUSTOM.

title.description: The h3 title without its number and without an italic *(…)* note. Plain text. Stands in for the description when there is none.

duration.description: « Durée estimée (minutes) » of the whole step.

description.description: Free text under the title, such as « Ce que l'animateur installe… ». HTML.

actions.description: The actions table, column « Action à cocher », in order, without the 1.1 numbering. One short, concrete action per entry; the app renders each as a checkbox.

materials.description: `#### Matériel` of the step: names from `materials`. A name missing there is added to the activity.
